description.text:
Discover UWTSD’s dynamic educational environment in the centre of London. With smaller classes and a variety of study as options, we prioritise an interactive learning experience that accommodates your life’s demands. Embracing diversity, we foster a highly supportive and friendly environment where learning is an engaging shared experience. Our commitment extends to your holistic development, enriching your personal journey with us. 

Step into London with UWTSD, where our campus, based in an iconic building at Westferry Circus, signifies more than teaching and learning – it’s a dedication to supporting mature students. Our experienced academic and professional service staff provide tailored support, from practical workshops and seminars, to 1-1 support that enriches your programme, ensuring your prepared for success. Cultivate lasting connections with our staff and experience an engaging learning atmosphere. At UWTSD London, we strive to introduce you to industries related to your interests, allowing for personal and professional growth. Choose an education that can transforms lives.

Immerse yourself in one of the world’s most captivating and vibrant cities and explore the diversity of city life at Canary Wharf and beyond, whilst surrounded by a thriving business community, including global brands and start-ups.
